46/S0.subgoal: Outline the scope of empirical evaluation within the system implementation process.

46/S1.subgoal: Explain the difference between testable and untestable research questions.

46/S2.subgoal: Describe the relationship between independent and dependent variables in an experiment.

46/S3.subgoal: Explain the importance of selecting representative user profiles when planning an experiment.

46/S4.subgoal: State the recommended number of participants needed to draw reliable conclusions from empirical data.

46/S5.subgoal: Define and explain the necessity of using representative tasks in an experiment.

46/S6.subgoal: Distinguish between within-subject and between-subjects experimental design.

46/S7.subgoal: Analyze the impact of the practice effect and describe methods to mitigate it.

46/S8.subgoal: Explain why statistical analysis is necessary before drawing conclusions from empirical data.

46/S9.subgoal: Determine whether collected data is statistically significant or the result of chance.

46/S10.subgoal: Select the appropriate statistical test based on the experimental design and data type.

46/S11.subgoal: Recap the major stages and concepts of the empirical evaluation process.
